checks.basis: check_inputs pins the exact manifests and hashes all split/sidecar/source files as bytes. run_evaluation lines 299-302 permits distinct test/ood splits only; train/calibration/validation typed records are not parsed.

All cases indexed by family IDs are retained when their family split is requested. Inclusion and ordering use corpus, split, group ID and case ID; no reference-based sampling, success filter or max-cases branch is present. Heldout request/reference validation can reject a corrupt corpus as a whole, not selectively remove unfavorable cases.

All family JSON metadata is decoded, including train/calibration/validation family records. Each case line's leading ID is separately JSON-decoded to find its family; the full case payload is decoded only after the requested-split check. Therefore this evaluator does not decode nonheldout case references, but it must not be described as decoding zero nonheldout JSON payloads of every kind. Its family-metadata access differs from the stricter preflight router.

Phone attributes must match both the number and set of actual candidate IDs. Under the pinned independently audited sidecars this gives one reference entry per actual candidate, including distractors and partials, so actual-A region scoring does not require a gold candidate.

A error and actual selected_id none return before B construction. Every valid non-none phone selection constructs B through phone_attributes(original_request, selected_id); the stored reference B request is never used for dispatch.

A presence is classified by the fixed inclusive p >= 0.5 threshold and retained independently. No presence condition gates the B branch. summarize separately scores presence and requires true presence only for complete_output_on_unique_target, not exact_raw_span or final_value.

A span may correctly equal reference none on a candidate miss. exact additionally requires a unique target, a valid actual non-none candidate, matching text/start/end and span correctness. Thus a miss with none gets raw Choice credit but exact_raw_span and final_value remain zero while the unique-target denominator is retained.

A copied or formatted distractor can have a successful guard, but exact requires the requested target's full source span and reference span ID. Both email value_ok and phone value_ok require exact. Repeated strings at different offsets do not satisfy full-span equality.

The B-region numerator compares the prediction with actual_ref selected by A's predicted span. Eligible B failures stay in that conditional denominator. expected_ref from the requested target is consulted only for reference formatting availability and final-value equality, never to repair the dispatched B input or replace its region decision.

All unique targets increment exact_raw_span, final_value and complete_output totals independently of A/B success: email 448 (128/320), phone 912 (272/640). Phone value_available is a fixed audited reference condition, so e164_on_reference_formattable_target totals 285 (85/200) even when A/B fails or A selects none/the wrong candidate. Unknown/review/misses remain zero in final_value over all 912 unique targets; None equality cannot create success.

Email reference_value_available is raw reference text availability: 448/448, while recalled/copyable actual target candidates are 280/448. Phone reference_value_available is reference E.164 availability: 285/912. These are different disclosed coverage definitions, not model accuracies. The reviewed documentation explicitly explains both.

The formatting denominator follows audited normalized_reference.status, not the metadata valid flag. The frozen 285 formattable targets include 85 globally possible but metadata-invalid targets (test 19, OOD 66). Invalid syntax/impossible numbers/conflicts/unknown region require review according to the frozen policy; metadata invalidity alone does not always imply review.

outcomes is initialized once for every selected case before execution. Per-case exceptions update status without dropping entries, and finally summarizes the full lists by corpus/split. Pending A cases and unattempted/failed B cases remain in their applicable fixed denominators. A successful raw span may still retain its A credit when B subsequently fails; final-value success remains false.

After service_identity passes and matches any existing lock, stable is set before validate_response. A schema-invalid first answer cannot erase that metadata lock and allow later identity drift to establish a new one. This is inspection of call order, not an independent audit of the shared identity helper or proof of loaded weights.

is_model_quality_evidence requires ordinary HTTP mode, state complete and a nonempty stable identity. Fixture transport, completed_with_errors and interrupted_or_failed runs cannot receive that flag. This flag is implementation metadata and does not make this static review model evidence.

denominator_evidence.method: Read the already frozen independent preflight report and compare its exact populations with the final evaluator's control flow and counter conditions. No evaluator loader, summary function or fixture was executed.

limitations: Static source/control-flow review only; no model inference, evaluator import/execution, loader run, fixture execution, HTTP or remote/GPU operation occurred in this review.
No new dataset case, family or split payloads were parsed during this review. The frozen preflight report supplied all denominator counts.

The evaluator itself does import frozen producer builders/reference functions for heldout integrity validation and phone normalization. This report does not claim that the evaluator never uses producer reference code; it verifies references are not substituted for predictions or used to dispatch B.
Exact default loader population/order equality and real loopback software behavior are reserved for a separate reviewer and are not asserted here.
B-region and guard populations depend on actual model selections. Only the document, unique-target and reference-formattable populations above are fixed before inference.
Successful unknown/review guard behavior is not copied/formatted requested-target extraction success. Metadata validity, formatting possibility and routability are distinct.
Phone data uses a finite fictional number pool with cross-split reuse; this review establishes no unseen-number generalization, real phone validity or reachability.
No owner test results are reproduced or claimed as independently verified by this report.

related_frozen_test_source.scope: Hash verified only. This reviewer did not execute or independently review the owner's tests.

reviewed_documentation.scope: Read to confirm loading disclosure, actual-A conditioning, denominators and email reference-value semantics. Broader runtime/tokenizer/test claims are outside this static review.
